description: This file implements the RequestHandler class for managing lifecycle and interactions within a plugin framework, including initialization, termination, and request handling for application lifecycle events.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle requests, initialization, termination, and communication with runtime and window managers within the plugin framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RequestHandler with service and event handler, setting up ripple, runtime, and window managers.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up resources used by RequestHandler.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Attempts to launch an application with the specified context and intent.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Requests termination of an application with the specified context.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the application identified by the context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of the application.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the runtime manager handler instance.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.

methods.name: getEventHandler
methods.description: Returns the event handler associated with the request handler.
